rodadas.explica: PART-TIME = meio período. FULL-TIME = período integral.
APPLY = candidatar-se. APPLICATION FORM = ficha de inscrição.
"Subject: Job application" e "I am writing to apply for the cashier position": Carla está se candidatando à vaga.
rodadas.texto:
From: carla.souza@email.com
To: hr@greenmarket.com
Subject: Job application: Cashier

Dear Mr. Brown,
I am writing to apply for the cashier position. I have two years of experience in a supermarket, and I can work full-time.
Please find my résumé attached.
Best regards,
Carla Souza

rodadas.destaque: What is attached to the email?
rodadas.explica: "Please find my résumé attached" = segue meu currículo em anexo.
rodadas.texto:

rodadas.destaque: How does Carla end the email?
rodadas.explica: "Best regards" é uma despedida formal. "Dear" abre o e-mail.
